title: Troggs in the Diggings

texts.details:
You're headed east through the pass? Then take a warning with you.

We broke into a hollow under this quarry and troggs came out of it like ale from a split cask. The same thing happened at Ironband's dig in Loch Modan. I'll wager it's for the same reason: these things were shut under the stone long ago, and every time the Explorers' League digs deep we let more of them out.

The mountaineers at the Valley of Kings should hear it from someone who has seen it. Through the South Gate, the first tower beyond the tunnel. Ask for Cobbleflint. Tell him: if there are troggs in the hills of the Loch, look to whoever has been digging.
texts.objectives: Bring Prospector Gehn's warning to Mountaineer Cobbleflint at the Valley of Kings in Loch Modan.
texts.completion:
Troggs at Gol'Bolar too? An' the League let them out. Well. That's a thing nobody in Ironforge will want to hear said aloud.

Here's what ye've walked into, $N. The troggs hold the hills south o' Thelsamar. The Dark Irons have their eye on the Stonewrought Dam, an' if that goes, the whole Loch goes with it. An' there's three of us in this tower.

Thelsamar's up the road to the north. They'll have work for ye, an' a pint.

idea: On the road from Dun Morogh to Loch Modan: the troggs were let out by the dwarves' own digging, and what waits in Loch Modan.
